rust_abci.transport: TCP socket with protobuf length-delimited framing

callback_cycle: Info reports the last durable application height and hash
InitChain runs once for an empty daemon store
CheckTx admits the transaction to the mempool
ProcessProposal rejects a proposal containing an unknown transaction
FinalizeBlock deterministically creates the pending state and application hash
Commit atomically persists the pending state
a restart repeats Info and replays a missing persisted height

timing_inputs.finalize_block: block time and decided-last-commit votes; no individual vote timestamps or vote extensions
timing_inputs.extend_vote: block hash, height, block time, transactions and prior commit
timing_inputs.prepare_proposal: local-last-commit extended votes, including vote extensions and extension signatures
timing_inputs.conclusion: U08/U09 require explicit committed observation evidence; block time alone is insufficient

height_sequence: transaction bytes and their Merkle root are committed by the signed header at H=15
FinalizeBlock at H=15 returns the new application hash and deterministic transaction result
Commit durably records application state height=15 value=1
the signed header at H+1=16 commits the H=15 application hash and transaction-results root
compatibility_conclusion: The pinned daemon source and Rust crates interoperate over ABCI socket transport on macOS and the verifier compiles for all five targets. G02 must design committed member observation evidence because FinalizeBlock lacks the individual timestamp/signature material required by U08/U09. Non-macOS known-answer runtime execution remains an operational gate.
